name: PCB Heatmap
description: Interactive multilayer DC current, voltage-drop and estimated board-temperature maps. Local KiCad 10 analysis.
description_full: A free local analysis plugin for KiCad 10. Click pads or copper in a saved PCB view to define voltage sources, current loads and component heat. Includes filled copper zones, tracks, pads, via spans, multilayer DC distribution and coupled steady-state board temperature estimates. Inspect temperature, current density and voltage-drop overlays by layer and net without changing the coupled model. Includes English/Turkish UI, grouped contacts, visibility controls, saved scenarios, generic material settings and isolated read-only analysis snapshots. NumPy and wxPython must already be available in the tested Windows KiCad installation. No account, network access, subscription or downloaded solver is used. Engineering prototype: requires mesh-refinement checks and independent measurements. Does not model semiconductor junction temperature, switching losses automatically, airflow CFD, radiation, heatsinks or thermal-interface materials. Not a certified ampacity calculator. Windows / KiCad 10.0 SWIG testing release.
